definition: A painting or artistic image.

definition: A spoken or written message.

contrast: shiwari is sending; shëliro is reading.

definition: To hear a sound.

contrast: sëmi means possessing knowledge.

contrast: shërawë is belief/acceptance as true.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Trust or confidence in another.
restriction: Abstract state; seeing a trust is generally a figurative/metalinguistic construction.

source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To cherish or care deeply for another.
restriction: Not automatically sexual, romantic, reciprocal or permanent.
contrast: rawëli is desire/want, not deep care.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To smile or show happiness.
restriction: A smile does not entail consent or agreement.
contrast: këmuro means to agree.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To protect or guard.
restriction: May take a person or object; claiming protection does not establish actual safety.
contrast: hari is possession, not protection.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A member of the Nardoragon species.
restriction: A species noun, not a grammatical gender or personality judgement.
contrast: mara is a social relationship.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A song or musical composition.
restriction: The object or work is distinct from the speech/song performance.
contrast: shiri means speak, not universally sing.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To speak or say words.
restriction: Does not guarantee the listener heard or understood.
contrast: ronaro means hear and shiroawe means listen.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To read or interpret written words.
restriction: Reading does not imply accepting the content as true.
contrast: shërawë means believe.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

canonical_gloss: write; mark language on a surface
definition: To write or mark language on a surface.
restriction: Writing a message does not mean it was sent or received.
contrast: shiwari is transmission.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To give or offer.
restriction: Giving and accepting are separate social actions; often a -tu recipient appears.
contrast: pëmi is to buy.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Good, safe, or well in context.

contrast: shëmoa specifically means broken/not functioning.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Tired or fatigued.
restriction: Not a synonym for sickness or emotional grief; may coexist.
contrast: sura denotes grief.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Cute or endearing.
restriction: Affectionate evaluation, not an automatic assertion of consent or romantic interest.
contrast: nashi means cherish.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Broken or not functioning.
restriction: A device can be broken without a person being unwell; do not use as a generic negative.

source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To answer or reply.
restriction: A reply can be inaccurate and need not resolve the original question.
contrast: sharoa is to ask.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To apologize or say sorry.
restriction: An apology is not automatically forgiveness or an admission of every alleged act.
contrast: rawëlë is to forgive.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A promise or commitment.
restriction: A promise's truth, attainability and scope need independent specification.
contrast: shëna is trust, not a contractual obligation.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A question or inquiry.
restriction: Question words and he mark speech acts; an inquiry need not imply uncertainty.
contrast: sëma is truth, which may be unknown.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To ask or request information.
restriction: Asking is not granting permission or issuing an obligation.
contrast: përoa is answering.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To learn or gain knowledge.
restriction: Learning is gradual, not the same as being a teacher.
contrast: yarëmi is to teach.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To teach or instruct.
restriction: Teaching does not automatically imply that a student learns.
contrast: rëmi describes learning.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Today, the current day.
restriction: A temporal nominal, not a blanket claim about the future.
contrast: yurayaro denotes tomorrow.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Tomorrow, the next day.
restriction: Date depends on speaker's local context; not a fixed calendar date.
contrast: nënayaro is today.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A memory or remembered moment.
restriction: A recollection is not the same as direct evidence that an event happened.
contrast: sëma is truth.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A story or narrative.
restriction: Can be fiction; do not treat a story as a direct historical source.
contrast: moru is a remembered moment.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To dream.
restriction: Dream content does not attest future events or facts.
contrast: sëmi means know.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Future or future time.
restriction: A noun for a future period, not the tense suffix itself.
contrast: -yu is future tense on verbs.

source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Fire or flame.
restriction: A physical fire can be figurative determination only in established literary context.
contrast: namu is a promise, not a flame.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Grief or sorrow.
restriction: An emotional experience, not automatically clinical illness.
contrast: shërohi is physical/mental fatigue.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A river or flowing water.
restriction: A watercourse is not the same as drinking water by default.
contrast: kima is water as a substance.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A storm.
restriction: Seeing a storm is not by itself a prediction that flight is impossible.
contrast: lugoqa denotes weather generally.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Mountain.
restriction: A physical elevated landform; figurative obstacles require explicit context.
contrast: wëru is a forest.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A forest or woodland.
restriction: A place/environment, not an action of traveling through it.
contrast: gura is travel.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To trade or exchange goods.
restriction: Trade requires exchange context, not merely a gift.
contrast: pëli is to give.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To buy or purchase.
restriction: Buying differs from giving and often presupposes payment.
contrast: pëli is to give.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To pay or provide payment.
restriction: The payer/action is separate from the price of a good.
contrast: pëmi is the purchase.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A choice or option.
restriction: Having an option does not establish equal power or absence of pressure.
contrast: -ho is permission; -ki ability.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To work or perform a task.
restriction: Working does not entail finished or successful work.
contrast: -mo marks completive aspect.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Star.
restriction: Astronomical body; figurative inspiration is an editorial interpretation.
contrast: wena is the sky as a whole.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: Sky.
restriction: A surrounding region, not a single star or a personal destiny.
contrast: sëra is a star.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A compass.
restriction: The instrument can be damaged or read incorrectly.
contrast: sëmi is knowledge; a compass does not guarantee it.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: A secret or confidential information.
restriction: Confidential content should not automatically be repeated because it is known.
contrast: shiwaro is a message that may or may not be private.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To break or make something nonfunctional.
restriction: Only licensed for an affected object; unrelated to violating a promise unless lexicalized.
contrast: ngëquza means break a promise.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved

definition: To forgive or let go of blame.
restriction: Forgiveness does not necessarily restore trust.
contrast: shëna is trust.
source_status: individually written editorial profile; not independently approved
